reviews.comment: I took him Fall 23 and it was his first year teaching. He was all over the place and many times nobody knew what he was talking about. Please take someone else!!

I quite honestly only got an A because I took AP stats in high school. I guarantee you that if you didn't take AP stats and take his class you won't understand a thing. There are always errors in his quizzes. He sometimes has an attitude and can seem irritable when you ask him a question you genuinely don't understand. Avoid at all costs.

The lectures were easy to understand and there wasn't much work assigned besides the homeworks and quizzes. There were daily participation quizzes that weren't graded based of accuracy and were simply done for attendance. Exam weren't too bad if you studied the slides. Overall, a great professor and helped me understand basics for higher stats.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Cahill is an extremely new and inexperienced teacher, as is evident through his lectures. As someone who took AP statistics in high school and ended with an A, his class was difficult to follow. I would NEVER recommend Professor Cahill, especially to someone who has never taken a statistics class before.

He curved, otherwise I would have barely passed the class. Exams have horrible stats, most ppl bomb them bc he doesn't do his job well. He contradicts himself and doesn't explain things. You have to teach yourself. Not good at answering questions in class. One weekly assignment with questions 10x easier than exam questions so they're no help.

Professor Cahill doesn't teach material very clearly, so you're going to have to teach yourself. Studying for his tests is hell because you realize that you didn't understand anything at all. Make sure to study everyday for this class or your doomed. It's a teach yourself kind of class where the professor just doesnt do their job.

Very difficult to understand during class and was opten unclear when speaking, stuttering and tripping over his words. I had to teach all the material to myself or I would've failed the class for sure. If you're good at teaching yourself stuff because the professor is bad at it, this is the class for you, but remember attendance is mandatory.
Worst professor I have ever had in my college career
